headline: Distill small models with frontier quality for 40%+ lower cost using wmo
summary: Experiential Labs introduces wmo, a new tool that transforms agent traces into continuous model improvement. It helps achieve frontier model quality with over 40% lower operational costs.
details: Experiential Labs has launched wmo, a new tool designed to distill and serve small models with frontier quality at significantly reduced costs. It promises over 40% lower operational expenses by leveraging existing agent traces for continuous improvement.

The wmo platform uses world model simulations, meta-harness optimization, and model distillation to achieve these gains. Developers can distill their own small models, serve optimized single models, or build optimized harnesses for their agents.

The optimizer can modify various components, including prompts, tools, policies, skills, and runtime code. Every candidate change is rigorously measured against simulated tasks, ensuring only improvements that pass evaluation gates become the new versioned champion harness.

Users can create an account at platform.experientiallabs.ai and authenticate via CLI. The system supports hosted agents running in platform-managed E2B sandboxes, with options to evaluate local optimizations in E2B environments.

WMO also incorporates anonymous usage telemetry to track volume, strictly collecting metadata. This telemetry never includes sensitive information such as prompts, traces, actions, observations, or user content, ensuring privacy.
caption:

headline_marked: [[Run Unlimited Claude Code]] on Your Cursor Subscription for Free
headline: Run Unlimited Claude Code on Your Cursor Subscription for Free
summary: A new Rust binary, cursor-bridge, allows developers to utilize their existing Cursor subscription's unlimited Auto model to power Claude Code CLI, bypassing separate Anthropic API costs or Pro plans.
details: A new open-source tool, cursor-bridge, enables developers to run Claude Code CLI using their existing Cursor subscription's unlimited Auto model. This bypasses the need for separate Anthropic API credits or a Claude Pro plan, offering a cost-effective solution for AI-powered coding.

Unlike other proxy solutions that require managing background servers, environment variables, or specific ports, cursor-bridge operates as a single, self-contained Rust binary. It requires no daemon, npm install, or manual configuration, simplifying its use significantly.

The tool directly replaces the `claude` command, internally managing the proxy lifecycle, spawning the CLI, and cleaning up automatically once the session ends. This streamlined approach eliminates setup complexity and ongoing maintenance for users.

It's important to note that cursor-bridge is an independent project and is not officially affiliated with Anthropic or Cursor/Anysphere. Users should exercise caution and use the tool at their own discretion, as highlighted by its creator.
